title: logger日志记录不支持中文解析

linked_prs.title: [Hot Fix]Fix text display in logger
linked_prs.patch:
diff --git a/src/agentscope/agents/dict_dialog_agent.py b/src/agentscope/agents/dict_dialog_agent.py
index be376105a7..a04185fc14 100644
--- a/src/agentscope/agents/dict_dialog_agent.py
+++ b/src/agentscope/agents/dict_dialog_agent.py
@@ -145,7 +145,7 @@ def reply(self, x: dict = None) -> dict:
         ).raw
 
         # logging raw messages in debug mode
-        logger.debug(json.dumps(response, indent=4))
+        logger.debug(json.dumps(response, indent=4, ensure_ascii=False))
 
         # In this agent, if the response is a dict, we treat "speak" as a
         # special key, which represents the text to be spoken
diff --git a/src/agentscope/models/model.py b/src/agentscope/models/model.py
index 813d037b7f..e2200525e8 100644
--- a/src/agentscope/models/model.py
+++ b/src/agentscope/models/model.py
@@ -114,7 +114,7 @@ def __str__(self) -> str:
             "image_urls": self.image_urls,
             "raw": self.raw,
         }
-        return json.dumps(serialized_fields, indent=4)
+        return json.dumps(serialized_fields, indent=4, ensure_ascii=False)
 
 
 def _response_parse_decorator(
@@ -223,7 +223,10 @@ def __init__(self, config_name: str, **kwargs: Any) -> None:
         """
         self.config_name = config_name
         logger.info(f"Initialize model [{config_name}]")
-        logger.debug(f"[{config_name}]:\n {json.dumps(kwargs, indent=2)}")
+        logger.debug(
+            f"[{config_name}]:\n"
+            f"{json.dumps(kwargs, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False)}",
+        )
 
     def __call__(self, *args: Any, **kwargs: Any) -> ModelResponse:
         """Processing input with the model."""
diff --git a/src/agentscope/utils/logging_utils.py b/src/agentscope/utils/logging_utils.py
index c074c77618..8f7cf0eb29 100644
--- a/src/agentscope/utils/logging_utils.py
+++ b/src/agentscope/utils/logging_utils.py
@@ -95,7 +95,12 @@ def _chat(message: Union[str, dict], *args: Any, **kwargs: Any) -> None:
             <content>".
     """
     # Save message into file
-    logger.log(LEVEL_CHAT_SAVE, json.dumps(message), *args, **kwargs)
+    logger.log(
+        LEVEL_CHAT_SAVE,
+        json.dumps(message, ensure_ascii=False),
+        *args,
+        **kwargs,
+    )
 
     # Print message in terminal with specific format
     if isinstance(message, dict):
